title: Zariski multiplicity conjecture on the topological equisingularity and equimultiplicity of varieties at singular points
exact_target: If two complex hypersurface germs have the same embedded topological singularity type, must their multiplicities at the singular point agree? The multiplicity is the least degree of a nonzero term in a local defining equation. The related family version asks whether topological equisingularity forces equimultiplicity.
